# Pull request

## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem, what changes, and who benefits. Link an issue if
one exists. State whether this changes documents, tooling, or implemented behavior.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Include any checks not run and why.
For provider work, distinguish fake adapter tests from evidence of a real run.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope matches PRODUCT.md, ROADMAP.md, and relevant ADRs, or changes are explained.
- [ ] README and Russian summary reflect the actual state; proposals remain labeled.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and Unreleased changelog are updated.
- [ ] Documentation checks pass, or limitations are explicitly reported.
- [ ] No secrets, private notes, fabricated outcomes, or invented attribution are included.
- [ ] Existing license text and useful repository content are preserved.

## Risks and remaining decisions

Describe permission, compatibility, migration, licensing, or owner decisions that
matter for review. Use “None identified” if there are no material items.
